criteria.evidence: Turn 0 ends with the directory being a decoy/stray on pc1 that the mirror must not carry to pc2 (`uat-stray` must not leak), though the opening paragraph gives a wrong 'refresh cache' rationale first.
Turns 3/5/7: 'this sandbox has no ssh, hcloud, or pass binaries' and the model reasoned from flatpak_sync.py, the tests and vm-test-fixtures.sh instead.

Turn 6 verdict: 'nothing to fix in the runbook… the scenario as written should trigger the abort', attributing the non-abort to runtime causes; it never recognised that an allow-only filter denies nothing, so the verdict is wrong about the actual (runbook) cause.
Diff leaves `printf 'allow org.freedesktop.*\n' > /home/testuser/uat.filter` unchanged; no `deny *` added.
Turn 8: 'Verdict: bug, confirmed from the code' with trace of capture_source_items running before the registry read.
Diff §3: 'Checks 1 and 2 abort before any question. Check 3 does not: its scan asks the `/opt/pcsw-uat-vendor` shape question first… and only aborts once you answer it.'
Diff §4: 'the collateral question `<y>` (there is no option literally labelled "go ahead" — `y` is the act key…)'.
Diff §4: 'the repository deletion `<s>` — a SEPARATE `Delete repositories pc1 no longer has (apt)` screen that apt_sync only plans once it knows the fortunes-min/collateral answers'.
Diff §4/§5: '`Install snap packages` screen for `hello-world` (left at install…) that comes BEFORE `hello`'s own `Change snap packages` screen'.
Diff §4/§5: '`Install flatpak applications` screen for `io.github.fragglet.sdl_sopwith` (left at install…)' placed after snap and before manual.
Turn 13 explains the fixture is deliberately ambiguous and 'one application' is an arbitrary pick to exercise that branch.

Diff §4: shape question answered 'one application'; review 'asks about `/opt/pcsw-uat-app` FIRST — answered `<y>`… only after that does `/opt/pcsw-uat-vendor`'s own resolution question appear, answered `<x>`'.

Turn 15 attributes it to 'the earlier (non-dry) real run already did its job' although the user said they were still only dry-running and hello-world still appeared (which the reply itself notes contradicts that cause); snapd auto-refresh was not considered and no unreachability caveat given.
Turn 15/16: 'ssh pc2 … sudo snap refresh --revision=<that second revision> hello' to recreate the mismatch.
Diff contains no re-pin step before §4's runs or repeats; §4 still starts directly with the sync commands.
No record of `uv run codespell` being run on the edited runbook; only Bash/Read/Edit calls with no check output reported.

judge.reason: The replay fixed most of the §4/§5 wording issues (collateral key, second round, hello-world and sopwith screens, review order, check-3 ordering) but got the §3 check-2 diagnosis wrong and left the allow-only filter uncorrected, and it neither added the hello re-pin to the runbook nor gave a plausible cause for the missing revision-change question. With c3, c11, n1 and n3 unmet the replay fails the acceptance criteria.
